• Ziftomenib Development Milestones o Initial topline results from the frontline KOMET-017 registrational program are anticipated in 2028, representing a key milestone in evaluating the potential to expand ziftomenib into newly diagnosed AML. o Eight ziftomenib abstracts will be presented at the 2026 American Society of Hematology (ASH) Annual Meeting, including: – FLT3 inhibitor combinations: Two oral presentations will report encouraging preliminary results for ziftomenib plus quizartinib and 7+3 intensive chemotherapy in newly diagnosed NPM1 -m/ FLT3 -ITD+ AML (KOMET-007) and ziftomenib plus gilteritinib in R/R NPM1 / FLT3 co-mutated AML (KOMET-008). – Longer-term frontline outcomes: A KOMET-007 poster will report updated durability, survival, and MRD outcomes with ziftomenib plus venetoclax and azacitidine, supporting continued evaluation of the ziftomenib-based low-intensity combination in the global randomized phase 3 study in newly diagnosed NPM1 -m AML. 3 – Additional molecular subtypes: A KOMET-001 poster will provide data supporting prospective evaluation of ziftomenib-based therapy in molecularly defined AML populations most likely to benefit from menin inhibitor therapy beyond the current US FDA-approved indication.
Based on its current operating plan, Kura expects its 4 financial resources to support operations beyond anticipated initial topline results from the pivotal Phase 3 KOMET-017 study in 2028.
